title: Compare group sizes and first IE
statement:
Which pair correctly compares Li and Rb?

[_]{a}

choices: Rb is larger and has lower first IE.
Rb is smaller and has lower first IE.
Rb is larger and has higher first IE.
Both have equal radius and IE.
explanations: The outer electron is farther out and more shielded.

hints: Its outer electron occupies a higher n.
The radius rises and first ionization usually falls down the group.
solution: Rb is lower in Group 1. Its outer electron occupies a higher n. The radius rises and first ionization usually falls down the group. The outer electron is farther out and more shielded.
